responsibility: Declares the overflow-aware integer arithmetic interface used by the imported D front end. The header publishes the checked signed and unsigned add, subtract, negate, and multiply helpers for 32-bit and 64-bit integers, with each routine returning the fixed-width result and updating a caller-supplied sticky overflow flag. It is the public contract for code that needs explicit range-checked integral operations, with the implementations living in `checkedint.c`.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface file in the checkedint pair: it only publishes the function prototypes and required integer-type includes for the checked arithmetic helpers, while the executable overflow-checking logic is defined in `gcc/d/dmd/checkedint.c`.
